name: Serra
description: Serra is a human planeswalker from the distant past, a benevolent healer with an affinity for angels who created Serra's Realm and was worshipped as a goddess.

summary.text: Serra is a human planeswalker from the distant past, a benevolent healer with an affinity for angels who created Serra's Realm and was worshipped as a goddess.

bio.text: Serra created the artificial plane Serra's Realm as a haven where suffering could be avoided, defended by angels and her archangel Radiant.

bio.text: She healed the fleeing Urza in her realm, but the Phyrexians tracked him there and their black mana tainted it, so Serra abandoned the Realm and Radiant took over.

bio.text: Elsewhere she arrived on Ulgrotha, encouraged peace and became the protector and goddess of Aysen, where she met and married Feroz and worked with him on the Ban that sealed the plane.

bio.text: In March of the Machine, a voice first wearing the likeness of Elspeth's mother was revealed as Serra, who embraced Elspeth, told her fear is last to leave and remade her with wings.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm, drives away Serra, and leads to Radiant's coup; Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza was able to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria

citation.text: "Angel", section "Serra angels". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra creates Serra's Realm.
timeline.quote: She created her heavenly plane

citation.text: "Serra", section "Creation of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra creates the Realm hoping to build a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.
timeline.quote: Serra made the Realm in the hopes that she could make a haven where suffering could be avoided forever.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Urza leaves, the Phyrexians attack; repelled, their black mana taints the Realm and Serra proposes an exodus and flees.
timeline.quote: their black mana forever tainted the realm, causing Serra to propose a massive exodus to the realm inhabitants and flee.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexians track Urza to the realm, taint it, and Serra abandons it, entrusting Radiant.
timeline.quote: entrusting the archangel Radiant as its caretaker in her absence

citation.text: "Serra", section "Collapse of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra heals Urza at Serra's Realm; Phyrexians track them down and they escape to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Urza and Xantcha planeswalked to Dominaria, escaping the destruction.

citation.text: "Xantcha", section "Travel with Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sengir meets Serra and Feroz and warns them not to interfere.
timeline.quote: After the arrival of Feroz , the Baron met the two planeswalkers and invited them to his castle.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Feroz's death, Sengir reprimands Serra, who leaves Ulgrotha.
timeline.quote: shortly after, Serra left Ulgrotha.

citation.text: "Sengir", section "Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra's Gargoyles watch the city though she has not been seen in twenty years.
timeline.quote: "Though Serra has not been seen for twenty years, her Gargoyles still watch over our city and punish the guilty."

citation.text: Abbey Gargoyles (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Murat doubts Serra ever existed.
timeline.quote: "The Matrons still say Serra is coming back. I bet she never even existed."

citation.text: Abbey Matron (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gulsen expects Serra to return to choose the Abbot's successor.
timeline.quote: "Soon, Serra will return and choose the Abbot's successor, else we are lost."

citation.text: Hazduhr the Abbot (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taysir tells Daria that Serra and Feroz are long dead but their spirit survives.
timeline.quote: "Serra, like Feroz, is long since dead. But remember, Daria: her spirit shall survive so long as the Homelands do."

citation.text: Serra Aviary (Homelands, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the last unspoiled oasis Feroz meets and marries Serra; together they work to restore the plane and create Feroz's Ban.
timeline.quote: he met fellow planeswalker Serra , whom he married.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a lab accident and the grief-stricken Serra abandons the plane.
timeline.quote: Later, Feroz died during a lab accident, and the grief-stricken Serra abandoned the plane.

citation.text: "Homelands", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra falls in love with Feroz and lives with him on Ulgrotha until he is accidentally killed.
timeline.quote: Feroz himself was accidentally killed before her eyes

citation.text: "Serra", section "Living with Feroz on Ulgrotha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra is attacked in Sursi by a black-aligned planeswalker, wastes away, and sanctifies the land.
timeline.quote: She used her last strength to sanctify the land around Sursi.

citation.text: "Serra", section "Murdered in Sursi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra arrives, encourages peace among the nomads and founds Aysen, becoming its protector goddess.
timeline.quote: she encouraged peace between the various plains nomads and the foundation of the state of Aysen

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz arrives and falls in love with Serra; Baron Sengir moves against them; Feroz founds the Wizards' School.
timeline.quote: with whom he quickly fell in love

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz and Serra cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it from planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: decided to cast a magical barrier over the world to guard it against further despoilment at the hands of strangers

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Feroz dies in a laboratory accident and Serra is manipulated by Sengir into leaving the plane; the ban begins to fail.
timeline.quote: Feroz tragically died in a laboratory accident, and Serra was manipulated by Sengir to leave the plane in sadness and guilt

citation.text: "Ulgrotha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra fulfilled the prophecy of the goddess for whom she was named.
timeline.quote: Serra fulfilled the prophecy of that goddess's coming.

citation.text: Serra (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pursued by Phyrexian negators, Urza and Xantcha flee across planes and land in Serra's Realm, where Serra helps Urza recover.
timeline.quote: There Urza recovers with the help of the plane's white planeswalker creator Serra.

citation.text: "Planeswalker (novel)", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians pursuing Urza send legions into Serra's realm and leave it tainted.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians sent countless foul legions into Serra's realm.

citation.text: Absolute Grace (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant tells Serra to go and leave the world to those who truly care.
timeline.quote: Go, then," the angel spat at Serra

citation.text: Catastrophe (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra tells Urza that Xantcha is recovering and her magic would have killed her.
timeline.quote: Xantcha is recovering.

citation.text: Healing Salve (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra tells Radiant it is not her place to rule.
timeline.quote: It is not your place to rule, Radiant.

citation.text: Humble (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Urza tells Serra he cannot fight and only wants rest.
timeline.quote: I do not care if I live or die, so long as I can rest.

citation.text: Pacifism (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra tells the custodians to guard Urza as he heals for five years.
timeline.quote: Serra told them to guard Urza as he healed. Five years they stood.

citation.text: Sanctum Custodian (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra is killed on Dominaria by an unnamed planeswalker who wants her ring.
timeline.quote: Serra leaves Ulgrotha and is killed on Dominaria by an unnamed planeswalker who wants her ring.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza flees from plane to plane, visits Zendikar and is healed by Serra, after which the Phyrexians corrupt her realm.
timeline.quote: Urza came to Serra's Realm and was healed by Serra

citation.text: "Urza", section "Exploring the Origins of Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The story departs from Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback showing the origins of the Legacy, meeting Teferi as a student and Serra at the peak of her power.
timeline.quote: Urza's Saga departs from the story of Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback, showing the origins of the Legacy

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radiant says Serra ruled by faith and she cannot afford it.
timeline.quote: Serra ruled by faith. I cannot afford that luxury.

citation.text: Hope and Glory (Urza's Legacy, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A speaker urges a follower who lived for Serra's love to die for it.
timeline.quote: Will you not die for it?

citation.text: False Prophet (Urza's Destiny Promos, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra's warriors ask in horror where their Lady is.
timeline.quote: Serra's living warriors looked on in horror.

citation.text: Defiling Tears (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A column gives a history of the shrine to the Angel planeswalker Serra at Epityr.
timeline.quote: It gives a history of the shrine to the Angel planeswalker Serra at Epityr .

citation.text: "From the Library of Leng", section "The Temple of Serra". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4308 AR Karona, Sash and Waistcoat visit a recreated Realm where an angel calling herself Serra says she has been rebuilding it since the powerstone exploded.
timeline.quote: Serra had been working to rebuild the realm since then.

citation.text: "Serra's Realm", section "Recreation of Serra's Realm". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra's teaching: believe in the ideal, not the idol.
timeline.quote: Believe in the ideal, not the idol.

citation.text: Worship (Ninth Edition, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karona and her disciples meet Serra, who tells her Dominaria is her true home.
timeline.quote: Serra's only advice was to remind Karona that she was Dominaria's magic

citation.text: "Karona", section "Karona in the Multiverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra created Serra's Realm as a refuge from pain and misery.
timeline.quote: Created on the foundations and principles of white mana by the planeswalker Serra

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Serra is forced to flee her Realm as it begins to Planar Collapse.
timeline.quote: Serra herself was forced to flee her Realm as it began to collapse under the corruption.

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Josu raids the Dawnvault and Caligo Morass; the Traveler destroys him with Serra's help.
timeline.quote: With divine help from Serra , the Traveler destroyed Josu.

citation.text: "Josu Vess", section "Liched". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra's realm proves as fragile as glass.
timeline.quote: As Serra was to learn, the peace and sanctity of her realm were as fragile as glass.

citation.text: Crystal Chimes (Commander 2015, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tiana realizes Serra feeds her knowledge of the Weatherlight since she revived the Powerstone.
timeline.quote: It had been happening since she had brought the Powerstone back to life.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Empowered by Serra, Tiana drives her sword into the phoenix and pushes it into the sea.
timeline.quote: Tiana shot up into the fire and drove her sword in right under its breastbone.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Lyra Dawnbringer says Serra has more faith in you than you have in her.
timeline.quote: "Whatever faith you have in Serra, she has more in you."

citation.text: Healing Grace (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance.
timeline.quote: "The spirit of Serra raised Brindri high and commanded her to keep the balance."

citation.text: On Serra's Wings (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A figure claims Serra lives on through her.
timeline.quote: "Serra isn't dead. She lives on through me."

citation.text: Serra Avatar (Commander 2018, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Serra speaks a single word, 'Hope', into the smothering dark.
timeline.quote: Into the smothering dark, Serra spoke a single word: 'Hope.'

citation.text: Abiding Grace (Modern Horizons 2, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Radiant plucks the stones from Urza's eyes in Serra's Sanctum and dies when she puts them together, restoring Urza.
timeline.quote: Radiant then foolishly put the two stones together, triggering an explosion that killed the angel and restored Urza.

citation.text: "Mightstone and Weakstone", section "Reunification in Urza, Planeswalker". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is told by the voice, now in her mother's likeness, that she must make one more choice about where to intervene as the planes burn.
timeline.quote: You must choose where to intervene,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is shown the Phyrexian assault on New Capenna led by the corrupted angel Atraxa.
timeline.quote: "They call her Atraxa."

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
timeline.quote: "This isn't the place," she says.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
timeline.quote: Killing her will not end this.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Time stops; Serra appears among the prisoners and reveals the choice is whether Elspeth keeps Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.
timeline.quote: It's to keep Nissa occupied long enough for Wrenn to reach the tree.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Serra she is afraid, and Serra embraces her, tells her fear is last to leave and remakes her.
timeline.quote: "Fear is always the last thing to leave,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reborn with wings and returns to time as Jin-Gitaxias attacks, meeting his claws with her sword.
timeline.quote: She is Elspeth, and she is not.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Episode 6: The Last to Leave" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Norn defiles Serra's temples with monuments to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Serra was a symbol of hope to Dominaria, so Norn defiled her temples with monuments to Phyrexia.

citation.text: Wind-Scarred Crag (March of the Machine, 2023), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: An echo of Serra guides Elspeth, reawakening her as an archangel.
timeline.quote: she awoke to see an echo of Serra, who guided her to her destiny

citation.text: "Serra", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: bestowed the power of an archangel onto Elspeth

citation.text: "Elspeth Tirel", section "Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The first encounter between Feroz, Serra and Baron Sengir took place at An-Havva Inn.
timeline.quote: It was here that the first encounter between Feroz , Serra and Baron Sengir took place.

citation.text: "An-Havva", section "An-Havva Inn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra arrives around 3750 AR, encourages peace and the founding of Onella; the country is named Aysen.
timeline.quote: She encouraged peace amongst the nomads, and the foundation of their first city

citation.text: "Aysen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra becomes protector and eventually goddess of Aysen.
timeline.quote: Serra became the protector and eventually goddess of Aysen.

citation.text: "Aysen", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Taysir's arrival banishes Sandruu and destroys the Anaba minotaurs' mural history, prompting Feroz and Serra to act.
timeline.quote: Feroz and his wife Serra decided it was time to do something

citation.text: "Feroz's Ban", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Greater Sea", section "Serra's Isle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Serra appears and dispatches the spider

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "The Planeswalkers and the Vampire". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "Feroz's Ban". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Serra lets an attacker kill her; Angus builds the Cathedral of Serra.

citation.text: "Homelands (comic)", section "Sengir's Triumph". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.quote: Feroz and Serra were married in a minotaur ceremony.
